title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Description

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is the senior operational leader of U.S. Hunger, responsible for translating enterprise strategy into daily execution. This role owns P&L performance across all business lines â Full Cart, Hunger Projects, and the Data/Intelligence engine â ensuring the organization's earned-income model (97%+ of total revenue) operates with precision, accountability, and scalability.

The COO must bring the instincts of an entrepreneur and the discipline of a corporate operator: connecting dots others miss, asking tough questions that drive clarity, and building the systems that allow talented leaders to perform at their highest level. Operational excellence and mission-aligned impact are not in tension here â they are the same thing.

Enterprise Operations & P&L Execution

  • Own P&L execution across all business lines â each engine must meet its margin, revenue, and impact targets.
  • Establish and drive the operating cadence â monthly reviews, quarterly business performance reporting, and clear accountability across departments.
  • Make resource allocation decisions across competing priorities â deploying people, capital, and attention against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Present operational performance, capacity, and growth execution to the Board of Directors.
  • Partner with the CEO on scenario planning, structural growth strategies, and enterprise-wide decision-making.

Program Leadership â Full Cart & Hunger Projects

  • Provide executive oversight of Full Cart and Hunger Projects â ensuring delivery excellence, measurable outcomes, and scalability.
  • Partner with program directors to evaluate, evolve, and scale programs in response to partner needs, market opportunities, and operational realities.
  • Drive integration between program design, data infrastructure, and client-facing delivery â ensuring mission impact and revenue execution are operationally connected.
  • Oversee supply chain and logistics operations to ensure consistent, high-quality program delivery at scale.

Revenue Growth & Partner Execution

  • Own enterprise revenue execution across health plan partnerships, corporate engagement, and strategic growth opportunities â ensuring acquisition and retention targets are consistently met.
  • Drive strategies that deepen existing partner relationships and expand engagement across multiple service lines, maximizing long-term value and organizational sustainability.
  • Represent U.S. Hunger externally with payors, partners, and stakeholders â translating operational insight into compelling value propositions that differentiate USH in the market.
  • Leverage buyer-side CSR experience and existing relationships across the corporate social impact and food access ecosystem to accelerate partner acquisition and deepen engagement.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the Chief Technology Officer to define business requirements, program design priorities, and operational needs that shape the technology and data roadmap â ensuring platform delivery enables execution across all business lines.
  • Manage the VP of Finance & Enterprise KPIs and VP of People & Culture â two executives who maintain direct visibility to the CEO through their seat at the executive table â ensuring fiscal discipline, enterprise analytics, and workforce strategy are aligned with operational goals.
  • Actively contribute to organizational governance, strategy, and enterprise-wide decision-making as the CEO's primary operational counterpart.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operational leadership team â setting clear expectations, driving accountability, and coaching leaders who are growing into executive-level roles.
  • Develop performance metrics and accountability systems that connect individual and team outcomes to enterprise financial and impact objectives.
  • Promote a culture of rigorous inquiry, collaboration, and continuous improvement â where leaders are expected to think critically, challenge assumptions, and own their outcomes.
  • Foster an environment where staff understand both the business drivers of USH's earned-income model and the transformative impact of their work on the communities served.

These essential job functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other duties as required.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in operations, business management, or revenue execution â with direct P&L ownership.
  • Experience building, running, or scaling a business â including sales growth, client retention, and financial performance accountability.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop directors and VPs â coaching strong operators into executive-level leaders while holding them accountable to outcomes.
  • Demonstrated pattern of connecting dots across functions â seeing how operational, financial, people, and program decisions impact each other.
  • Experience at the board level â presenting performance, defending strategy, and engaging C-suite stakeholders directly.
  • Experience in mission-driven, earned-income environments where market discipline and social impact must coexist.
  • Strong communication across corporate, nonprofit, healthcare, and community sectors â direct, polished, and confident.
  • High emotional intelligence, with the courage to ask tough questions, the polish to challenge constructively, and the vision to see what's possible before it's obvious.
  • Background check is required for this role

Essential Physical Skills

  • Repetitive finger motion as used in computer use.
  • Extensive work with computer screens
  • Everyday requirements of bending, grabbing, holding, and lifting light objects
  • Work on Hunger Projects requires heavy lifting (up to 50 lbs), moving objects, pushing, and pulling, bending and kneeling
  • Up to 50% travel time

title: Tequila Market Manager New Jersey
description:
Tequila Market Manager â New Jersey

Location: New Jersey

Brand: Bandero Premium Tequila

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $85,000 Base Salary | Commission | Full Benefits

About Bandero Premium Tequila

Bandero Premium Tequila is a fast-growing premium spirits brand entering an exciting new stage of national expansion. With increasing distribution, major retail opportunities, high-profile events, and strategic partnerships, Bandero is building meaningful momentum across the United States.

The brand is expanding its presence in key markets, developing strong relationships with leading distributors and retailers, and creating memorable consumer experiences through tastings, sponsorships, hospitality programs, and brand activations.


As Bandero continues to grow its national footprint, New Jersey represents a major opportunity for visibility, influence, and long-term sales growth. We are seeking a driven Market Manager who is excited to help build the market, secure influential placements, and become an important part of the brandâs continued expansion.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, connected, and results-driven New Jersey Market Manager to lead Bandero Premium Tequilaâs growth throughout the state.


This is an opportunity to join a growing brand at a pivotal stage and play a direct role in shaping Banderoâs success in one of the countryâs most important and competitive wine and spirits markets.

The New Jersey Market Manager will be responsible for increasing sales, supporting distribution teams, securing new on-premise and off-premise placements, and building lasting relationships with key accounts and industry leaders.


The ideal candidate has strong roots in the New Jersey hospitality and beverage community, existing relationships with buyers and decision-makers, and the entrepreneurial drive to build a premium spirits brand in a competitive market.


Key ResponsibilitiesDistributor Management
  • Work closely with Banderoâs distributor partner to execute sales programs and achieve market goals.
  • Build strong relationships with distributor leadership, managers, and sales representatives.
  • Conduct regular distributor meetings, sales presentations, ride-alongs, and account visits.
  • Motivate and support distributor teams to increase placements, reorders, and overall sales.
  • Monitor distributor inventory, depletions, execution, and performance against established goals.
  • Ensure distributor activities remain aligned with Banderoâs sales strategy and premium brand positioning.
Account Management and Sales
  • Leverage existing relationships and build new connections to grow Banderoâs presence throughout New Jersey.
  • Secure new on-premise and off-premise placements.
  • Develop relationships with key buyers, beverage directors, restaurant groups, retailers, bars, hotels, lounges, nightclubs, and other influential accounts.
  • Manage existing accounts and identify opportunities to increase reorders, menu placements, displays, and promotional support.
  • Create targeted sales plans for priority accounts and high-value opportunities.
  • Maintain a consistent market presence through regular account visits and follow-up.
Brand Building
  • Serve as a knowledgeable and enthusiastic ambassador for Bandero Premium Tequila.
  • Host tastings, staff trainings, buyer presentations, events, and activations that reflect Banderoâs premium image.
  • Educate distributor teams, retail staff, bartenders, servers, and consumers on the Bandero portfolio and brand story.
  • Identify local partnerships, sponsorships, and events that can increase visibility and consumer engagement.
  • Ensure Bandero is represented professionally and consistently across all customer and consumer interactions.
Market Development
  • Identify opportunities for expansion throughout New Jersey.
  • Monitor competitive brands, pricing, promotions, account activity, and market trends.
  • Provide insight into the New Jersey market landscape, culture, and key industry players.
  • Help develop localized sales, marketing, promotional, and activation strategies.
  • Collaborate with company leadership on programs designed to increase distribution and brand awareness.
Reporting and KPIs
  • Track and report on placements, reorders, depletions, sales targets, account activity, and promotional effectiveness.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective and active accounts.
  • Provide regular market updates, sales reports, competitive insights, and opportunity assessments.
  • Manage market expenses responsibly and submit timely documentation.
  • Work toward clearly defined sales and distribution goals.


Qualifications
  • Proven experience in sales, brand building, market management, or account management in the New Jersey market.
  • Existing relationships with New Jersey buyers, distributors, retailers, restaurants, bars, hotels, nightlife venues, or hospitality groups are strongly preferred.
  • An established book of business is a significant plus.
  • Demonstrated success opening new accounts and growing existing business.
  • Experience managing, supporting, and motivating distributor partners.
  • Strong understanding of the New Jersey wine and spirits market, including its culture, key accounts, and industry landscape.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, relationship-management, and organizational skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to manage a large territory independently.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Passionate about premium spirits and building a growing brand from the ground up.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including occasional nights and weekends, for events, tastings, and activations.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout New Jersey as required.
  • Valid driverâs license, clean driving record, and reliable transportation.
  • Must meet all legal requirements for representing and promoting an alcoholic beverage brand.


What We Offer
  • $85,000 annual base salary.
  • Commission based on sales performance.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Accrued paid time off and sick time.
  • Paid company holidays.
  • Reimbursement for approved business and travel expenses.
  • Dynamic and entrepreneurial work environment.
  • Opportunity to play a key role in growing Bandero Premium Tequila throughout New Jersey.
  • Opportunity for advancement as the brand continues to expand nationally.

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
Job Snapshot

Location: Remote - California (San Diego or Southern California Preferred)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $28-30 per hour

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Environment: Remote

Reports To: Human Resources Manager

About Pacific Health Group

At Pacific Health Group, we care deeply about the people and communities we serve. We meet individuals with kindness, respect, and understandingâlistening first, honoring each person's journey, and offering support without judgment.

Through compassionate, person-centered healthcare, behavioral health services, and social supports, we walk alongside people as they work toward healing, stability, and a healthier, more hopeful life.

Our Core Values

  • Speak with integrityâclear, respectful, and honest in every interaction
  • Embrace innovation, trying new ideas, learning fast, and improving care.
  • Own our roles, staying accountable for outcomes and documenting accurately
  • Build genuine connections with members, families, and teammates through empathy and cultural sensitivity
  • Lead with trust by being consistent, transparent, and following through
  • Celebrate wins together, recognizing individual and team achievements
  • Collaborate with purpose, partnering across departments and with community providers to solve problems
  • Ask for support and offer support, because thriving together is how we serve our members best

Role Overview & Impact

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Coordination

  • Support candidate communications using approved templates
  • Track candidate status and documentation in the applicant tracking system
  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)
  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

  • Submission of an internal application
  • Recruiter pre-screen
  • Skills assessment if applicable
  • Final interview with hiring leadership
  • Formal verbal offer from authorized hiring representatives

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

AI & Human Interaction in Recruitment

Pacific Health Group uses AI tools to assist with resume matching based on qualifications, skills, and location. All qualified applications are reviewed by our recruiting and HR team to ensure fair, equitable, and human-centered hiring decisions.

title: Range Keeper
description:
LOCATION: Burwash Training Ranges

The Range keeper reports to the Project Manager and will provide Shooting Range services for the Military Outdoor Training Ranges located Burwash Ontario.

You must be suitably physically sound and adaptable enough to do moderate lifting and to walk over rough terrain, have experience/knowledge in the operation of shooting ranges, have a general property maintenance background and be able to operate small-medium sized machinery/tools such as tractors with various attachments (i.e. farm tractor, lawn mower, aerator, front-end bucket, snow blower) power hand mowers, trimmers, walk behind snow blower, plow truck, power saws and hand tools including but not limited to shovels, hammers, saws, rakes, telephones.

You will be required to work on a flexible schedule on weekdays, weekends and evenings according to range reservations/ schedules as presented by the Company Office.

You must be a self-starter, demonstrate a good work ethic and provide superior customer service. You will need to display good communication in the English Language as well as inter-personal and organizational skills. Within your duties you will be expected to interface with DND/Police/civilian range users as well as assigned subcontractors.

Key Responsibilities

Your duties include

Scheduling

  • Repair targets/backings 1080 fig. 11 targets/backings and 1080 targets/backings for fig 12 at Winona Range as well as replacement of 24 figure 11 target frames and 48 target frames for figure 12.
  • Repairs include removing and replacing the paper target figures.
  • Provide flexible hours to accommodate the march in/ march out process which includes occasional evening/weekend activity
  • Oversee in and out inspections.
  • Regularly inspect all range property and infrastructure reporting work order needs to the Company office as required and conducting dayâto-day operation and maintenance as required
  • With exercise directors (OIC Exercise) conduct in/out inspections ensuring the ranges and buildings are properly returned as found by the users and March in/out forms are signed by the Exercise representative
  • Reporting, recording all incidents, damages, causes and vandalism (including graffiti in the Butts)
  • Report malfunctioning installed equipment including kitchen and laundry equipment
  • Get Project Manager authority before calling in subcontractors;
  • Ensuring First Aid Fire Fighting equipment/supplies are maintained and replenished.

Maintain Ranges/infrastructure

  • Walk the perimeter fence lines ensuring the fences are kept in good repair and growth is cut back to an acceptable level
  • Complete all grass cutting and snow removal and ice control operations with equipment provided iaw the performance standards provided by the Regional Manager
  • Prune trees, shrubs and plants as required for neat appearance and maintenance.
  • Build/Repair target frames ensuring sufficient are on-hand at all times replacing

Facilitiesâ Housekeeping

  • Conduct janitorial services in all range buildings.
  • Conduct routine repairs paying particular attention to occupant safety, protection of occupants and property against further damage
  • Provide janitorial supplies as required to assist Range visitors;
  • Institute suitable waste disposal and materials recycling;
  • Take appropriate measures for the control of pests both indoors and outdoors;
  • Pick up litter and garbage as required.

GENERAL REQUIREMNTS

  • Must have a valid Ontario driverâs license and be prepared to operate Company vehicles/equipment safely in the performance of their duties
  • Must work flexible hours according to Range reservations;
  • Must be prepared to wear and respond to calls
  • Will be required to pass a security clearance and adhere to the Company Code of ethics, Code of conduct and confidentiality agreements;

The expected salary range for this role is determined in accordance with the union collective agreement

title: Product Engineer
description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

  • You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.


How To Apply

We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.

Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.

When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.


Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane

  • Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.

  • Meaningful equity and real ownership.

  • Small team, fast feedback loops.

  • Remote role that lets you focus and create.

description:

Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

About The Role

The Onboarding Manager guides new customers who come from a partnership, through the implementation of Connecteam, from initial handoff and kickoff through a successful payroll launch. Implementations are payroll-first and planned around the customerâs first clock-in date, payroll schedule and go-live timeline. Depending on account size and complexity, the Onboarding Manager may continue supporting the customer through the first one to three payroll cycles.

  • Troubleshoot, escalate and document
    • Investigate issues across the full workflow.
    • Determine issue owner and route it appropriately
    • Escalate payroll-impacting risks with clear documentation
    • Maintain accurate account records, architecture decisions, risks, next steps and handoff documentation.
Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, customer facing SaaS role with SMB & Mid Market client sizes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn software, troubleshoot issues, and understand integrations and data flows.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer-first approach when managing complex implementations.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with customers, internal teams, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and changing customer needs.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with payroll, HRIS, workforce management, scheduling, time & attendance, or employee management platforms.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, PEO environments, or multi-location/multi-entity organizations.
  • Experience working in a partner-led or channel-based customer environment.

Benefits:

    • Paid time off for vacation, sick days
    • 401k
Salary: $90K

We are accepting applications from employees working in the following states: Texas, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina, North Carolina, Colorado, Florida, Utah, and Georgia.

Joining Connecteam Is The Smart Move:

  • We make an impact on our customerâs business. We are on a mission to provide managers of all business types and sizes with the tools they need to communicate, operate, engage, and run their deskless workforce. Our product offers them an effective and affordable solution to run their business.
  • We get the job done. Connecteam employees are passionate in executing their job duties so they can drive the company forward and provide real value to our customers.
  • We have fun! From weekly happy hours to holiday parties, we always enjoy each otherâs company (and good food, of course). Connecteam is like one big, happy family!

Together we will shape the future of work!
